description: Contractor and home service industry terms for Molly content generation. These seed content angles and make posts feel credible to trade professionals.

terms.definition: the distance between a contractor's current online presence and their top local competitor's
terms.content_angle: most contractors don't realize how big their gap score is until they lose a job to someone with a website

terms.definition: the 3-business map listing that appears at the top of Google for local service searches
terms.content_angle: every plumber in your city is fighting for 3 spots on Google — a website is what gets you in the ring

terms.definition: a prominent tap-to-call button on mobile specifically for after-hours emergency calls
terms.content_angle: one emergency call at 2am pays for a website — if they can find you

terms.definition: licenses, insurance badges, Google review counts, and years-in-business shown above the fold
terms.content_angle: homeowners decide in 8 seconds whether to call — trust signals are what they're scanning for

terms.definition: how fast new Google reviews come in — a high rate signals an active, trusted business
terms.content_angle: your competitor with 200 reviews didn't get them by accident — their website asks for them after every job

terms.definition: a site designed to look and work perfectly on a phone before anything else
terms.content_angle: 87% of homeowners search for contractors on their phone — if your site isn't built for mobile, you don't exist

terms.definition: dedicated landing pages targeting specific cities or neighborhoods a contractor serves
terms.content_angle: one service area page targeting a 10-mile radius can double the calls from that ZIP code

terms.definition: the natural limit of how much revenue a contractor can generate from referrals alone
terms.content_angle: every contractor hits the word-of-mouth ceiling eventually — a website is what breaks through it

terms.definition: a unique phone number on the website that tells the contractor exactly how many calls came from it
terms.content_angle: you can't scale what you can't measure — call tracking shows exactly what your website is worth

terms.definition: Trevo's standard turnaround time from intake form to live site
terms.content_angle: you lose a job to a competitor with a website on Monday. By Wednesday, you can have one too.

terms.definition: a Google Business Profile that exists but has no website link, no photos, and incomplete info
terms.content_angle: a ghost listing tells Google you don't care about new customers — and Google believes it

terms.definition: the visible portion of a webpage before a user scrolls — where decisions are made
terms.content_angle: you have 8 seconds and one screen. Trade name, phone number, what you do. That's it.

terms.definition: search queries spoken into phones or smart speakers like 'plumber near me open now'
terms.content_angle: plumber near me open now — someone just said that. Did your name come up?

terms.definition: a dedicated section showcasing Google review stars, count, and selected customer quotes
terms.content_angle: a homeowner with 3 plumbers in front of them picks the one with 150 reviews — every time

terms.definition: a visible indicator that the contractor offers payment plans or financing options
terms.content_angle: a $4,000 HVAC job becomes a yes when the homeowner sees they can pay $199/month

terms.definition: the percentage of website visitors who call, text, or book a job
terms.content_angle: 100 people visited your site this month. How many called? If you don't know, that's the problem.

terms.definition: running targeted promotions before peak demand seasons (AC tune-ups before summer, heating before winter)
terms.content_angle: HVAC contractors with websites run seasonal promotions. The ones without just wait and hope.

terms.definition: the revenue lost each month from customers who searched online, couldn't find you, and hired a competitor
terms.content_angle: you're not losing jobs to better plumbers. You're losing them to plumbers with better websites.

terms.definition: a simple job request form on the website that captures the customer's name, problem, and availability
terms.content_angle: your phone rings while you're under a sink. The intake form takes the job anyway.

terms.definition: a fully built, trade-specific website example Trevo shows prospects before they commit
terms.content_angle: you wouldn't buy a truck without a test drive. We let you see your website before you pay.
